results.title: BWF World Championships 2026: PV Sindhu, Ayush Shetty reach R16; Lakshya Sen, Unnati Hooda exit
results.description: Day 3 of the BWF World Championships 2026 in New Delhi brought mixed fortunes for India, with PV Sindhu and Ayush Shetty advancing to the Round of 16, while Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty progressed via walkover. Lakshya Sen suffered a shock defeat to American teenager Garrett Tan, while Unnati Hooda was knocked out by Canada’s Michelle Li.

results.title: Around 100 Feared Dead In Central African Republic Gold Mine Collapse
results.description: Rescue teams were continuing to search the site for miners who remained trapped beneath the rubble.

results.title: Pete Hegseth Accused of Hiding Truth Behind USS Lincoln's Supply Problems
results.description: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth is accused of downplaying the impact of Iranian strikes on a crucial US resupply base, which has affected the USS Abraham Lincoln's operations.
